title: gRPC ❤️ Cardano: A streaming API for Cardano using Dolos by TxPipe

ms.promise:
- Publicly available source code of the improved Dolos component including all of the required endpoints.
- A binary release of the improved Dolos component including all of the required endpoints.
- Documentation and instructions on how to interact with each of the newly available gRPC endpoints in Dolos.
ms.criteria: A developer is able to install the binary release of Dolos and follow the provided instructions to make gRPC calls to each of the newly created endpoints (watch, build, submit modules) using a generic gRPC client
ms.report:
We are pleased to announce the successful completion of Milestone #1 for the Dolos gRPC Catalyst project. This consists in the implementation of the remaining gRPC (or UTxO RPC) endpoints for all the modules, namely the submit, sync, watch and query (formerly called "build") modules.
We are proud of the rapid progress made during this milestone and are sincerely excited about opening up this working prototype of Dolos for feedback from the community.
Milestone goals and Evidence of Completion
・Source code: publicly available source code of the improved Dolos component including all of the required endpoints:
・https://github.com/txpipe/dolos/tree/main/src/serve/grpc
・https://github.com/txpipe/dolos/tree/main/src/querydb 
・Binary release: a binary release of the improved Dolos component including all of the required endpoints:
・https://github.com/txpipe/dolos/releases/tag/v0.8.0 
・Documentation: documentation and instructions on how to interact with each of the newly available gRPC endpoints in Dolos
・https://dolos.txpipe.io/apis/grpc 
・https://utxorpc.org/introduction
・Milestone summary video: A social post was published from the main developer describing the feature. It including technical details and short demo video:
・https://x.com/santicarmuega/status/1786351572802269476 

Next Steps
In the upcoming milestone, we will provide library packages for different programming languages of interest (Node.js, Rust, Python, etc.), in the corresponding package manager registries (respectively, npm, crates.io, pypi, etc.). Each of these libraries will be accompanied with suitable documentation and installation instructions for each of the client SDKs.
We believe the outcomes of the upcoming milestone might considerably impact mainstream adoption of Dolos as data node and streaming API for Cardano developers to leverage in their dApp projects. ms.promise:

- Documentation including simple examples of how to configure each of the libraries to use the newly added gRPC providers
ms.criteria: A developer is able to use existing frameworks in the ecosystem (Translucent, MeshJS) that use the new gRPC endpoints as backend providers with very little change required
ms.report:
Since the approval of the Catalyst proposal, the landscape of transaction building libraries has shifted. The Translucent project has been deprecated in favor of a new library called “Blaze” (evidence here). Our new provider implementation focuses on Blaze (49 stars at the moment of writing) because we consider that it matches what the developer community wants
﻿
Blaze
The code for our new provider lives in the following Blaze repo on the Butane repository: 
https://github.com/butaneprotocol/blaze-cardano/blob/main/packages/blaze-query/src/u5c.ts 
Documentation with instructions and examples showing how to use the new gRPC backend provider can be found here: 
https://github.com/butaneprotocol/blaze-cardano/blob/main/examples/u5c/index.ts 

Mesh
The code for our new provider lives in the following Mesh fork on the TxPipe repository: 
https://github.com/txpipe/mesh/blob/9e3e37455e098fcce58c8da1736ccdd9079ffef2/packages/mesh-provider/src/u5c.ts
Documentation with instructions and examples showing how to use the new gRPC backend provider can be found here: 
https://github.com/txpipe/mesh/blob/9e3e37455e098fcce58c8da1736ccdd9079ffef2/packages/mesh-provider/test/u5c/test.ts
